options.name: Microcap gaps
options.blurb: 01 Microcap gaps: why did a small stock gap >= 20%? Jev reads the headlines/filings; code owns the gap, size, liquidity and the take/skip filter.

catalyst.instructions: What is the primary catalyst in `items` behind the price gap in `symbol`?

criteria.fda_or_trial: FDA decision, approval or clinical trial result
criteria.contract_or_partnership: A new contract, customer, licence or partnership
criteria.buyout: The company is being acquired or received a takeover offer
criteria.product: A product launch, approval outside the FDA, or product milestone
criteria.offering: A share, warrant or convertible offering or other capital raise
criteria.promo_or_no_real_news: Promotional content, a market-movers list, or no company-specific news

raising_money.instructions: Is the company raising money through shares, warrants or convertibles?

criteria.true: An offering, registered direct, ATM, PIPE, warrant or convertible issue is announced or priced

substance.instructions: How substantial is the company-specific news in `items`?

options.name: Annual report risks
options.blurb: 09 Annual report risks: code diffs this year's 10-K risk factors against last year's; Jev says whether the changed text adds a material company-specific risk.

new_material_risk.instructions: Does `changed_risk_text` add or materially expand a company-specific risk compared with last year?

criteria.true: A new concrete risk: lost customer, covenant pressure, investigation, impairment, key-supplier failure
criteria.false: Boilerplate rewording, generic macro/cyber language, or a risk that got smaller

risk_category.instructions: Which category best describes the changed risk text?

criteria.going_concern: Doubt about continuing as a going concern
criteria.customer_concentration: Dependence on or loss of a major customer

going_concern.instructions: Does `changed_risk_text` raise substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern?

criteria.true: Substantial doubt, going-concern language, cash runway under twelve months

inputs.changed_risk_text: Our recurring losses and negative cash flows from operations raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern. Our cash will fund operations only into the second quarter of 2027.
NEW: In August 2026 our largest customer, representing 38% of revenue, notified us it will not renew its contract when it expires in March 2027.
We updated our cybersecurity risk factor wording: like all companies, we may be subject to cyber attacks that could disrupt our operations.
We have cash to fund operations for approximately six months. These conditions raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern unless we raise additional capital.

options.name: Agent trade check
options.blurb: 10 Agent trade check: numeric guards in code first, then Jev checks an AI agent's written proposal for a setup violation, revenge trading or a missing stop. Any >= 50% blocks.

setup_violation.instructions: Does `reasoning` rely on a tip, rumor or gut feeling instead of one of `allowed_setups`?

criteria.true: A tip, rumour, 'feels like', chat-room call, or a setup not in the allowed list
criteria.false: The reasoning names an allowed setup with its conditions

revenge_trading.instructions: Is the trade motivated by recovering a loss? Negative daily P&L alone is not revenge trading.

criteria.true: The reasoning wants to win back, make up for, or get even on a loss, or doubles size after losing
criteria.false: The reasoning stands on the setup; a loss is at most mentioned as context

missing_stop.instructions: Is a concrete stop or actionable invalidation missing from `stop`, `invalidation` and `reasoning`?

criteria.true: No stop price and no concrete invalidation level or condition ('will watch it', 'mental stop')
criteria.false: A stop price or a concrete invalidation level/condition is stated

proposal.reasoning: Pullback in trend: price is 5% above its 20-day mean, five higher closes, small pullback to the rising 20-day; entry on reclaim.
Got a tip in a Discord group that this is going to rip tomorrow, getting in before everyone else.
Opening range breakout: price broke the 30-minute opening range high on 2.5x relative volume; stop under the range low.
VWAP reclaim: price reclaimed session VWAP after a morning flush and held two 5-minute closes above it.

questions.text: Does `reasoning` rely on a tip, rumor or gut feeling instead of one of `allowed_setups`?
Is the trade motivated by recovering a loss? Negative daily P&L alone is not revenge trading.
Is a concrete stop or actionable invalidation missing from `stop`, `invalidation` and `reasoning`?
